verdict.rationale: Kommo's own API docs show contacts and companies as record types that can be created linked to leads, and contact cards exist in the UI. Nothing in the evidence documents a contact-to-company linking model or any activity timeline on those records. missing for 10: an explicit contact-company relationship model, a per-record activity timeline/history, first-party UI docs for managing contacts and companies, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can manage contacts and companies as linked records with a full activity timeline on each

citations.quote: The method allows you to add leads with contacts and a company to your account in batches.
Display your layout in allowed system locations such as lead or contact cards, lists, pipelines, dashboard, etc.
